1a45e9cf7ddbf1c8e41ac30d7fdf522b80fe9667.reference: Eleven last March; sixteen and a half in the later exchange. The difference between the stated ages is five and a half years.
1a45e9cf7ddbf1c8e41ac30d7fdf522b80fe9667.answer: The first statement is Anne saying she was eleven years old last March. The second statement is Anne saying she is sixteen years old. The difference is 5 years.
